title_zh: 核对汤的水量并分工准备

scenario.label_zh: 核对汤的用水量与准备分工
scenario.goal_zh: 澄清配方所需水量，决定先量水并分工准备黄油与蔬菜

context_zh: 室友妮可与本按照一本自有食谱准备晚餐。
author: author-phase08-b

sentences.speaker: Nicole
sentences.text: The recipe says one litre of water. Is that one full jug?

sentences.speaker: Ben
sentences.text: Not this jug; it holds two litres. Use the mark halfway up.

sentences.speaker: Nicole
sentences.text: Thanks. I'll measure the water while you chop the onion.

sentences.speaker: Ben
sentences.text: Do we put the butter straight in with the vegetables?

sentences.speaker: Nicole
sentences.text: It says to melt the butter first, then add them. Let's get everything ready before we turn on the heat.

sentences.speaker: Ben
sentences.text: All right. I'll finish the onion and put the butter beside the pan.
